title: Terrified of taking investment, a founder finds governance “can actually protect (as opposed to dilute) your mission”
summary: Halseid founded Synappro and Offlabel and says she had always been afraid that taking investment would force her to compromise her values. She credits David Thierry Knox with introducing her to the book's governance framework at a Generalist World event, and now recommends it to mission-led UK founders who are scaling.
blockquote: It's a game-changer for understanding how corporate governance can actually protect (as opposed to dilute) your mission.
